scope: Six current90d originals actually opened by root. Bounded static visual observations only; no Android, FPS, natural-scroll or complete Native approval. Separate geometry workflow defect remains. No transfer to a later source.

source_catalog.scope: Six newly produced original Puzzle menu rasters; candidates for actual Root inspection. No visual approval asserted.

images.observation: The classic stage shows1/6 parts with a piece placed on the central board, visible textured remaining pieces and the Das passt progress instruction. At640x360 the horizontal toolbar clips its trailing content and has a visible scrollbar; no claim of all controls being simultaneously exposed.

One current selection dialog is visibly present, with motif Leuchtturm-Bucht, Mini6 and Drehpuzzle selection plus the new-puzzle action. No duplicated older menu controls are visible in this static frame. At640x360 the final Zur Spielewelt item is partly below the viewport and a vertical scrollbar is visibly present; this review does not claim all items are simultaneously exposed or prove a natural scroll gesture.

The rotation-mode stage shows0/6 parts, the quarter-turn instruction, board and textured piece trays. The Drehen control and neighbour controls are readable. At640x360 the bottom toolbar is horizontally scrollable and trailing controls are outside the current viewport; this image does not establish their gesture accessibility.

One current selection dialog is visibly present, with motif Leuchtturm-Bucht, Mini6 and Drehpuzzle selection plus the new-puzzle action. No duplicated older menu controls are visible in this static frame. At960x540 all five menu buttons and the full title are visible within the dialog.

The classic stage shows1/6 parts with a piece placed on the central board, visible textured remaining pieces and the Das passt progress instruction. At960x540 the complete seven-control classic toolbar is visible.

The rotation-mode stage shows0/6 parts, the quarter-turn instruction, board and textured piece trays. The Drehen control and neighbour controls are readable. At960x540 the full eight-control toolbar is visible in the current view.
